raw_response:
I will keep cotton as my main crop because that is the crop system I know best, and on a 12 mu farm with only two people I need a plan that is familiar and manageable. I will split the land into 6 mu cotton, 3 mu wheat, and 3 mu maize. I will not chase the highest possible input level; I will use steady fertilizer rates and irrigation that match my labor, my experience, and the fact that I have well water. For cotton, I will use improved seed, plough the land well before planting, give it moderate nitrogen and stronger potassium, irrigate a few times at key stages, and spray several times because cotton usually needs the most pest control. For wheat, I will keep management stable with improved seed, enough nitrogen for tillering and grain filling, and three irrigations because wheat responds well to water here. For maize, I will also use improved seed, keep fertilizer balanced, irrigate twice, and control pests with fewer sprays than cotton. My goal is not to take big risks. I will aim for reliable yields and a workload I can finish on time.
